How 55 ALS Hypotheses Map Across Evidence, Validation Steps & Trial Readouts

Synthesizes donor-level statistics across 44 SHA-256-locked core replication datasets (8 participant-overlap and donor-accounting groups, 208 SHA-256-verified statistical records across 49 unique source files; supplemented by 33 external 2025–2026 validation cohorts cross-checked in the Living Research Log; zero new wet-lab data), unbound human brain PK, and GENCODE v46 off-target scans across four triage verdicts:

Four Evidence & Triage Verdicts (Untested ≠ Falsified)
  • Keep · Core (4): Supported by human ALS genetics and/or TDP-43 rescue with a CNS-viable modality.
  • Keep · Exploratory (28): Unresolved due to bulk-assay, dosing, or cohort blind spots, paired with 1 Go/No-Go test (includes 6 Tier 4 Parked Watchlist drugs that remain exploratory, never dropped).
  • Benchmark / Biomarker (7): Approved SOC comparator (2), clinical PD reference (1), CSF staging panel (1), or candidate CSF marker (3).
  • Drop · Falsified (16): Deprioritized at the tested regimen/exposure based on human ALS RCT futility (9), unbound CNS exposure or safety limits (7), or assay confounding (0).

Methodology & Decision Guide: Clinical Regimens, Molecular Targets & Evidence Triage
1. Clinical Regimens & Molecular Targets: Evaluates 55 ALS therapeutic & biomarker hypotheses across 6 biological evidence sources (including 18 complex/panel subunits and selectivity comparators) using donor-level statistics (Trautwig Emory TMT n=51 is a nested subset of n=77 DIA; multi-region NYGC/Pineda donors analyzed per-region without pooling) and unbound human CNS PK (Cu,brain / Kp,uu).
2. Untested ≠ Falsified Triage Rule: Never discards an untested hypothesis due to bulk-assay, fixed-library-concentration, or unstratified-cohort blind spots. Keep · Exploratory (28) denotes an untested preclinical/biofluid triage queue (not therapeutic endorsement; including 6 Tier 4 Parked Watchlist drugs held behind exposure or trial-data gates, never dropped) paired with prospective Go/No-Go criteria; Drop · Falsified (16) evaluates specific clinical drug regimens/exposures separately from molecular target pathways and requires positive human RCT futility, insurmountable CNS exposure/safety limits, or confounding collapse.
3. Combinatorial Portfolio Thesis: Pairs single-agent-qualified genotype-stratified intrathecal splice rescue (evaluating 2-plex KCNQ2 EALS-006 + STMN2 EALS-002 vs. 3-plex + UNC13A EALS-001 across rs12973192/rs12608932 genotypes at a 6–9 mg [≤3 mg/strand] total intrathecal ASO dose target vs. 12–50 mg nusinersen & 100 mg tofersen; ≥24–48 mg flagged as DRG/radiculotoxicity hazard) with oral non-covalent SARM1 ARM–TIR octamer stabilization (EALS-030, 1.0x parallel Bliss floor to ~2–7x modeled NMNAT2-coupled MWC bounds) and biomarker-gated neuroimmune modulation (EALS-031 BioVendor-bridged pNfH ≤3,700, Tier 3 oximetry-verified EALS-007 sST2, Tier 4 Parked EALS-019 high-chitinase CSF glial stratum).
Rank & Triage Key: Priority #Rk = translational priority (tier · trial landscape · validation steps · stage) · Evidence #Rk = curated human genetic & CNS pathology ordering (39 prioritized programs; editorial order, not win probability) · Keep·Exploratory (28) = untested triage queue (not endorsement) · Modeled estimates never rank candidates.
Data & Provenance Standards: Open Targets / NIH IDG TDL & TSA · GENCODE v46 Off-Target Alignment Screen · Linked Scripts, SHA-256 Checksums & Study-Type Evidence Categories · 100% open-access published tables/counts (1-based GRCh38 target windows; SantaLucia Tm/ΔG37 & AlphaGenome AVI never rank candidates).

Preclinical Research Notice & AI-Assisted Workflow Disclosure

Not Medical Advice: ExploreALS v2.0 is an independent preclinical and translational research resource intended solely for scientific hypothesis generation. Nothing herein constitutes medical advice, clinical trial recruitment, or a treatment recommendation; individuals with ALS and caregivers should always consult their neurologist or ALS care team before starting, stopping, or modifying any therapy.

AI-Assisted Methodology: Curated via human-directed AI synthesis workflows paired with deterministic Python statistical pipelines across 44 open-access human ALS and preclinical resources (published tables, raw counts, and structures; zero new wet-lab data) and primary-source verification (PubMed, Europe PMC, ClinicalTrials.gov). Quantitative contrasts and accessions are programmatically verified and separated from modeled biophysical and PK-PD estimates, though synthesis prose may contain residual errors; always verify against linked primary sources before experimental use.
